summary: REKLAMEPARTNER GRAPHICS AS (org. no. 979 895 909) is a private limited company (AS) based in Nordre Follo, in the Brønnøysund registers since 1998-06-16. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 73.110 (Reklamebyråvirksomhet); it has 9 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 28.4 m and net income was NOK 2.4 m. CEO: Gisle Nesbakk; board chair: Jan Ola Fredrik Bäckstrand Andersson; auditor: ERNST & YOUNG AS.
